help.title: How to play
help.1: Goal: score the most points over 4 races.
help.2: Draft: everyone rolls a die. The highest roller picks first and also takes the last card of each row. You end up with 4 runners that nobody else can see.
help.3: Before each race, everyone secretly chooses one runner from their hand; all are revealed together. Each runner races only once.
help.4: On a runner's turn a die is rolled and it moves that many spaces — its Main Move. Abilities change the rules: tap any card or standee to read it.
help.5: The race ends the moment a second runner crosses the Finish. 1st / 2nd place score 3/1, 4/2, 4/2 and 5/3 points in races 1–4.
help.6: From race 2 on, the player whose runner was last (or eliminated first) takes the first turn.
help.7: Whoever has the most points after race 4 wins. Ties share the victory.
help.ctl: Camera: drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag (two fingers) to pan, double-click to reset.
help.keys: Keys: 1–6 choose a number · Y / N answer · Enter confirms.
